lines.text: Many learners say: I am married with a teacher.
Better: I am married to a teacher.
To! She is married to a doctor.

data.wrong: I am married with a teacher.
data.right: I am married to a teacher.

native.tip: 결혼했다는 married to! “I am married to a teacher”예요.
native.caption: “I am married with a teacher”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘~와 결혼했다’는 with가 아니라 to를 써서 married to라고 해요. “I am married to a teacher”가 맞아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “to”. married to로 기억해요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Say married to, not with. “I am married to a teacher”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am married with a teacher”? 😅 To say who you married, use “to”, not “with”. “I am married to a teacher” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
